one_line: A real first-person story with an emotional first line, the product only after trust is earned.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman in a white T-shirt and a turquoise head wrap speaks to the lens, a bookshelf behind. Said (transcript) and subtitled in a black box: 'הבן שלי בחדר ניתוח, עובר ניתוח לב פתוח, וחברה שלי אומרת לי'.
q1_hook.why: A person speaks to the lens and the first line is already a crisis, which makes the viewer ask what the friend said (H4, H5, H1). Voice and subtitle start together (H6). It names no product or parent need yet, so the topic is unclear for about 45 s (H2).

beats.what: To the lens; 'הבן שלי בחדר ניתוח', 'לב פתוח', a friend's advice
beats.why: A crisis line that opens a gap.

beats.what: 'לפני 16 שנה', open-heart surgery at 4 months, a mother outside the operating room
beats.why: The backstory, told calmly and personally.

beats.what: 'מי חשבה על זה שאחר כך צריך לטפל בצלקת שלו?', 'לב קטן גוף קטן'
beats.why: The question the product answers, as a feeling.

beats.what: A photo of a bare torso with a scar and two red arrows; 'הצלקת בערך בגודל'
beats.why: The visual that makes the story real.

beats.what: A photo of a teen at a beach pull-up bar at 0:34; 'הוא ספורטאי', 'היא בכלל לא נושא'
beats.why: The emotional answer: the scar is not an issue.

beats.what: 'קלו-קוט היא המשחה הכי טובה', 'לטשטש אותה, פשוט כמו פס לבן'
beats.why: The product named only now, after the story.

beats.what: She holds up a gel tube, a UV gel, a spray; 'הג'ל הרגיל', 'כמות של פי שבע'
Back to plain frame; 'קראו את מה שכתבתי לכם', 'ושלא תצטרכו אבל אם תצטרכו, קלו-קוט.'
beats.why: A usage note and a warm sign-off.

beats.what: A beach clip of a young man on a pull-up bar, a stylised line 'בוגר מחלקת ניתוחי לב-חזה'

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Video: 'קראו את מה שכתבתי לכם מתחת לפוסט' (1:04). Caption: 'שמרו לכן את הפוסט שיהיה לכם זמין' and 'מוזמנות לכתוב לי בתגובות'. The caption has a save-worthy three-step guide.
q2_flow.why: A real story arc, crisis, worry, scar photo, result, is the pull for 45 s, with a photo as the only picture change (K2, H5). After a continuous talking take the product arrives at 0:51 (R3, R1). At 89 s it is long, but a beach clip ends it on a payoff (R2, R4). The caption's guide is save-worthy (R7).

q3_cta.what: In the video: 'קראו את מה שכתבתי לכם מתחת לפוסט' (1:04) and 'שלא תצטרכו אבל אם תצטרכו, קלו-קוט' (1:10). Caption: 'שמרו לכן את הפוסט שיהיה לכם זמין, וכל שאלה - מוזמנות לכתוב לי בתגובות'. No link, price or comment word.
q3_cta.why: The ask is soft: save the post, ask a question. A save has a stated use, a steps guide, and a question has a purpose (C2, R7). The video shows no CTA text and no link, so a viewer must search (C6, C3). Save and comment are two asks (C1).

q4_shown.what: From 0:00 her face and the bookshelf. A scar photo with red arrows 0:28; a teen at a pull-up bar 0:34; a gel tube 0:51, a UV gel 0:54, a spray 1:00; a beach clip 1:13 to 1:29. No application, price or before and after.
q4_shown.why: The proof is a first-hand story with a scar photo and a grown-up result, which carries more than the tubes held up (S6). No application or before and after is shown, and the medical claims are only said (K4). A minor's bare torso and a clip appear, a privacy question for LumeBook's own Reels (S5).

q5_edit.what: 5 shots in 89 s (cuts near 28, 31, 64, 73 s): one static take, a scar photo overlay at 0:28 and a teen photo at 0:34, then the beach clip from 1:13. Black-box subtitles, 2 to 4 words, at about 77% of frame height.
q5_edit.why: One steady take is clear, but for 45 s only her delivery and two overlays change (R3, E2). Short subtitle chunks work muted (E4, T1). 89 s is long for one message (R2), and the beach clip ends it on a payoff with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Why treating a child's surgical scar early mattered, and which of three Kelo-cote products fits which scar. Serves parents of a child with a scar.
q6_topic.why: A real worry, a child's visible scar, told by a parent who lived it, leaves the viewer feeling understood (K6). The warmth and pride end make it feel earned (K1). The 'it blends to a white line' claim is the creator's, and the caption adds timing and age claims (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod, static, eye level, at home with a bookshelf and warm window light. She faces the lens, gestures with both hands, and holds each product near her chest. The beach clip is a fixed wide shot.
q7_filmed.why: Direct eye contact and her own home look personal and honest (F6, H8, F7). The tubes are small and held low, partly under the subtitle, so labels do not read (F4, F2). The beach clip is a sharp, full-frame wide shot (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles in a black box, centred at about 75 to 78% of the frame height, 2 to 4 words per chunk, synced: 'הבן שלי בחדר' (0:00), 'לב פתוח,' (0:01), 'אז לפני 16 שנה' (0:04), 'לטפל בצלקת שלו?' (0:19), 'הצלקת בערך בגודל' (0:28), 'קלו-קוט היא המשחה הכי טובה' (0:45), 'הג'ל הרגיל' (0:57). Last: stylised 'בוגר מחלקת ניתוחי לב-חזה גבירותי ורבותי' over the beach clip. No headline card.
q8_text.caption: 'אנחנו מדברות כאן רבות על איך לעזור לילדים לאהוב את הגוף שלהם'. About 190 words: an appeal to watch for visible injuries, 'אצלנו זה היה משמעותי', three numbered steps (timing, routine, fit), age notes, 'שמרו לכן את הפוסט', 'בשיתוף @kelocote_il כמובן'. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Short boxed subtitles work muted (T1, T2) and sit in the middle, but inside the bottom 35% and with no headline card, so the topic is unclear for 45 s (T4, F2, T3). The caption is a searchable three-step guide, with no hashtags (T7). The partnership word is on the last line (T8, S7).

weak_points: The product appears only at 0:51; no headline card, so the topic is unclear for 45 s; medical claims with no source on screen; a minor's torso and clip; no CTA text; disclosure only on the caption's last line.
lumebook_takeaway: A true one-sentence story in the first line, the book held up near the middle, a headline card and one save-worthy caption guide. Hands and book.
not_verified: Whether the torso photo and the beach clip show her son (implied by her words, not confirmed); the medical claims; music (none evident); the paid label (0 per media info). Correction: the product tube first appears at about 0:51, the scar photo at 0:28 to 0:31, and the teen's photo at about 0:34; the video ends on the beach clip, and no on-screen CTA text appears. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
